```{r setup}
library(gamdid)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(msqrob2)
library(mgcv)
library(lme4)
library(reformulas)
library(harmonicmeanp)
library(stageR)
```

```{r}
leduc <- readRDS(file = "../tests/testthat/data/data_unittest.rds")
leduc_dd <- compDistr(object = leduc,i= "proteins_norm",covariate = "Field", adjust = TRUE, nuisance = ~ (1|Set), minObs = 30)
rowData(leduc_dd[["proteins_norm"]])
metadata(leduc_dd[["proteins_norm"]])

visFit(object = leduc_dd[["proteins_norm"]], feature = 7, plot = "hist")
visFit(object = leduc_dd[["proteins_norm"]], feature = 7, plot = "diff")
```
